digest.component_or_area: plan clarity and P1 readiness gates
propositions: Empty parsed Acceptance Criteria checklist items must fail standalone clarity and block plan-review P1 readiness deterministically
Unresolved sentinel assignments (TBD, TODO, FIXME, ???) in active execution sections must fail clarity when appearing as values or after specific triggers, ignoring code fences and negation contexts

A shared pure plan-structure parser must recognize standard checklist syntax, join continuation lines, and detect sentinels while suppressing matches on same-line negation terms (no, zero, remove, delete, reject, forbid, must not, without)
Existing clarity scores and ticket-type exemptions must remain unchanged while enforcing the new hard floors
Focused unit tests must verify empty checkboxes, sentinel detection forms, code-fence and negation suppression, and agreement between standalone clarity and P1 gates
